_comment: Template for lab/config.local.json. Copy to config.local.json (gitignored) and fill in. Never commit secrets — auth tokens stay in az login / pac auth profile.

auth._note: AzCli mode reads credentials from 'az login' user profile. Service principal (legacy) reads from env vars AZURE_CLIENT_ID / AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET / AZURE_TENANT_ID — never store in this file.

pac._note: Optional. If set, Invoke-Deploy.ps1 will run 'pac auth select --name <profileName>' before deploy. Leave empty to use the currently active pac profile.

billing._note: Power Platform PayAsYouGo billing policy that the lab env will be attached to so Copilot/AI Builder credits draw from your Azure subscription. Discover policies via GET https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/billingPolicies?api-version=2022-03-01-preview. Trial/Developer/Teams envs cannot be attached — keep allowedEnvironmentType at 'Sandbox,Production' to fail fast on env-type mismatch.

purview._note: Operator UPN must have Security & Compliance admin role for retention label creation.

entraAgentId._note: Set true if Microsoft Entra Agent ID is enabled in the tenant. If false, blueprint creation falls back to notes-only and smoke test warns instead of failing.
